description: Java class implementing a rule engine node for creating entity relations in Thingsboard, including configuration loading, message handling, relation checking, and creation logic.

classes.name: TbCreateRelationNode
classes.description: A rule node class for creating relations between entities based on message content and configuration.

methods.name: loadEntityNodeActionConfig
methods.description: Loads and converts the node configuration, checking if the entity type is supported.

methods.name: createEntityIfNotExists
methods.description: Determines if the entity should be created if it does not exist, based on configuration.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, manages relation creation, and updates message originator if configured.

methods.name: checkRelationAndCreateIfAbsent
methods.description: Checks if a relation exists between two entities and creates it if absent.
